data.name: Bolsheviktion 3D
data.detailed_description:
BOLSHEVIKTION 2 - YUROVSKY'S REVENGE Announced!

The sequel has been announced!

Bolsheviktion 2: Yurovsky's Revenge continues your vendetta against the murderous Bolsheviks—this time in pursuit of your kidnapped son. Coming July 17, 2026.


About the Game

Story

Russia, May 1918. In the midst of a civil war, the Bolsheviks have recently seized power. Tsar Nicholas II has abdicated the throne, and has been placed under house arrest in Alexander Palace. You're a diplomat sent to negotiate with the new regime, but instead are suspected of being a spy. Thrown into prison, you face a grim fate. But one night, you have a nightmare. A gruesome scene - a dark, dingy basement, covered in blood, with walls covered in bullet holes. Seeing dead bodies of young women and men, you realise it's the Tsar's family. Waking up in a cold sweat, you make a decision. When the morning guard comes in to check on you, you'll kill him, take his gun and make your escape. The Tsar needs you.

Features

Bolsheviktion 3D is written from the GROUND UP in pure C using a reimagined and enhanced implementation of John Carmack's original raycasting method. Full software rendering!

  • Battle your way through nine distinct locations to discover the whereabouts of the Tsar, fighting through the Bolsheviks' most brutal battalions

  • Four unique enemy types and two bosses to conquer

  • 4 difficulty modes - Give Me a Go, Dad, Don't Be So Tough, Let's Go Boys! -- and for the insane gamer -- BOLSHEVIKTOR! (not even remotely fair)

  • Collect treasure and even rarer royal treasure

  • Find secret pushwalls containing exotic and useful items for combat

  • Custom graphics, music and sound effects

Portuguese translation by Gustavo Carvalho De Souza Costa

Russian translation by Elena Beloborodova

Spanish translation by Erika Marcela Gomez Marin

data.short_description: Russia, 1918. Bolsheviks are in power. Imprisoned on suspicion of being a spy, you plan to bust out and save the Tsar and his family from certain death. BOLSHEVIKTION 3D's an old-school FPS: an alt-history Wolf3D. Acquire new weapons, collect royal treasure and blast your way to Ipatiev House.

All content contained in this game, including depictions of Nazi imagery and representations of certain minority groups, is created and presented solely for artistic purposes under Australian law.

In accordance with Australian federal and state laws, such as the Counter-Terrorism Legislation Amendment (Prohibited Hate Symbols and Other Measures) Act 2023 and various state laws (e.g., Victoria’s Summary Offences Amendment (Nazi Symbol Prohibition) Act 2022), the use of Nazi symbols and related imagery in this game falls under the exemptions for artistic, educational, or cultural purposes. These laws allow such depictions when they are made in good faith for a genuine artistic purpose and do not intend to incite hatred, violence, or discrimination.
